PRODUCT FEATURES & SPECIFICATIONS
 Superior Legibility: Easy-read dial with luminescent hands.
 Clinical Functionality: Prominent red second hand for precise vital sign measurement.
 Hospital-Tough: 3ATM Water Resistance & scratch-resistant mineral crystal.
 All-Day Comfort: Odorless, Light, Soft, adjustable silicone strap suitable for medical use.
 Always Accurate: Quality quartz movement with date display.
 Meaningful Details: Inspirational engraving and premium gift packaging.
 Versatile Design: Professional look perfect for both clinical settings and everyday wear.

THE PERFECT CHOICE FOR
 The CIVO Nurse Watch is the intelligent choice for nurses, nursing students, medical assistants, doctors, healthcare workers, and anyone seeking a functional, meaningful, and durable gift.

NURSE WATCH PACKAGE CONTENTS
 1 * CIVO Nurse Watch
 1 * Nurse Quartz Watch Instructions
 1 * Nurse Watch Microfiber Cleaning Cloth
 1 * Exquisite gift box

items.label: EASY TO CLEAN & COMFORT
items.value: With 3ATM water resistance, this nurse analog watch survives frequent handwashing, sanitizer exposure, and accidental splashes. Say goodbye to stiff, easily worn-out bands. Our soft 100% silicone strap is easy to clean and comfortable for 12-hour shifts, making it the ideal waterproof watch for medical professionals

items.label: EASY-TO-READ DIAL
items.value: Designed for nurses, nursing students, and medical staff who need accurate timekeeping in fast-paced clinical settings. Features a high-contrast white dial with bold 12/24-hour markers, Luminous hands, and a vibrant red second hand. Ensures reliable performance during critical moments in hospitals, clinics, and emergency settings. Case diameter: 38.5 mm

items.label: PRECISE AND DURABLE
items.value: The clear red second hand enables accurate pulse, while the reliable Japanese quartz movement ensures consistent accuracy. Designed for nurses, doctors, EMTs, caregivers, and students

items.label: THE GIFT FOR HER
items.value: Presented in Exquisite Packaging, this watch combines practicality with durability – making it perfect for everyday use. An ideal gifts for nurses, employees, colleagues, teachers, caregivers, mothers, students, friends, lawyers, doctors, and various other professions

items.label: QUALITY ASSURANCE & SUPPORT
items.value: Backed by reliable customer service and comprehensive after-sales support. Each CIVO Nurse Watch offering durable construction that withstands daily clinical use

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Nurse Quartz Watch Instructions, Nurse Watch Microfiber Cleaning Cloth
